change: Restore full-width garden workspace after direct-arrangement wrapper regression
evidence: User supplied iPhone LINE screenshot showing a narrow garden with unused right-side space.
cause: The new workspace flex item inherited cross-axis start alignment. Its automatic width could shrink to toolbar content while the contained scene used inline-size containment and percentage width.
fix: Give the workspace width:100%, max-width:100%, min-width:0 and align-self:stretch; explicitly size its scene to the workspace.
